notes: Agent hit a real skill gap: recording duration is frame-driven (nFrames x max(50, animationSpeed) ms, ~116 ms/frame default) and self-stops after the last frame, so --seconds only caps wall clock (40 frames gave 4.66 s, not 8 s). Worked around via the documented escape hatch (renderer.animationSpeed=200 through the same JS bridge). Improvement queued: add playback-speed control to export.py + document frame-driven duration semantics.
